name: Stormwind City Cemetery
summary: Tucked quietly behind Cathedral Square along the waters of Stormwind Lake, the city cemetery serves as the final resting place for Stormwind's fallen and nobility. Rows of modest gravestones stand in the shadow of grand mausoleums, offering a solemn sanctuary of mourning within the bustling capital.

sections.title: A Sanctuary of Mourning
sections.body: Situated just north of Cathedral Square, the Stormwind City Cemetery overlooks the peaceful expanse of Stormwind Lake. Beneath its weeping willows lie centuries of history, from ordinary citizens lost to recent wars to prominent figures of the realm. Chief among its monuments is the resting place of Queen Tiffin Ellerian Wrynn, the late wife of King Varian, whose untimely death during the Stonemasons' riot cast a long shadow over the House of Wrynn. The grounds offer both quiet solace for grieving families and a reminder of the kingdom's heavy sacrifices.

sections.title: Whispers in the Mist
sections.body: Beyond ordinary mourners, the graveyard draws lingering spirits and watchful shadows. The restless ghost of Sir Nicholas Gabaree is known to wander near his headstone, bound to the mortal plane. More discreetly, the cemetery's secluded pathways and shadowed vaults make it a favored location for covert meetings under the cover of night, occasionally utilized by operatives of SI:7 seeking rendezvous away from the prying eyes of the royal court.

faq.q: Where is the cemetery located in Stormwind?
faq.answer: The cemetery lies directly north of Cathedral Square, sloping down toward the edge of Stormwind Lake. It can be reached easily by walking past the Cathedral of Light into the quiet northern gardens.

Many common citizens, soldiers, and nobles are buried throughout the grounds. Most notably, it holds the tomb and memorial of Queen Tiffin Ellerian Wrynn, as well as the headstone of Sir Nicholas Gabaree, whose spirit still lingers nearby.

faq.q: What is the large unmarked tomb with the Lordaeron crest?
aliases: who is in the big tomb
faq.answer: Near Queen Tiffin's memorial stands a large mausoleum bearing the crest of Lordaeron, devoid of any plaque or identifying statue. Its occupant remains unidentified, though scholars and locals often wonder whether it honors heroes of the Second War or refugees from the fallen northern kingdom.

faq.q: Why do suspicious figures gather here at night?
faq.answer: Because of its quiet location and heavy shroud of weeping willows, the cemetery serves as a discreet rendezvous point for covert agents, including operatives from SI:7 conducting confidential exchanges away from the royal court.

angles.text: The dense monuments and quiet tree lines make the cemetery an ideal location for discreet handoffs and clandestine surveillance away from the city guard.
The cemetery stands as a solemn monument to Stormwind's losses, housing the tomb of Queen Tiffin Wrynn and memorials tied to the kingdom's recovery from past wars.
